text.short: Los Banos, on H Street. Family style, six days, and by its own account more than a hundred years old.
text.today: Private dining rooms, wine, and a book-by-email reservation. Same name as the Bakersfield room, a different house.
text.note: The house describes uniforms, artwork and family-style service; it does not publish its hours day by day.

seating.note: Family style, with private rooms for a party that wants one. Book by email.
